
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Vedant Shankar Jha — Portfolio</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;500;700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  :root {
    --bg: #0d1117;
    --bg2: #161b22;
    --bg3: #21262d;
    --border: #30363d;
    --cyan: #58a6ff;
    --cyan2: #79c0ff;
    --green: #3fb950;
    --orange: #f0883e;
    --purple: #bc8cff;
    --red: #f85149;
    --text: #e6edf3;
    --text2: #8b949e;
    --text3: #6e7681;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* Grid bg */
  body::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(rgba(88,166,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(88,166,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 40px 40px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .container {
    max-width: 1100px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 40px 24px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  .hero {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: 32px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
    padding: 36px;
    background: var(--bg2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -60px; right: -60px;
    width: 240px; height: 240px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(88,166,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .photo-wrap {
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .photo-wrap img {
    width: 130px;
    height: 130px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    border: 3px solid var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(88,166,255,0.15), 0 0 30px rgba(88,166,255,0.2);
    display: block;
  }

  .status-dot {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 6px; right: 6px;
    width: 16px; height: 16px;
    background: var(--green);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid var(--bg2);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green);
  }

  .hero-text {}

  .terminal-tag {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--cyan);
    background: rgba(88,166,255,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(88,166,255,0.25);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    display: inline-block;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  }

  .hero h1 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .hero h1 span { color: var(--cyan); }

  .hero-sub {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text2);
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .hero-sub .accent { color: var(--orange); }

  .badge-row {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .badge {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    font-weight: 500;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    border: 1px solid;
  }

  .badge-blue  { color: var(--cyan);   border-color: rgba(88,166,255,0.35); background: rgba(88,166,255,0.08); }
  .badge-green { color: var(--green);  border-color: rgba(63,185,80,0.35);  background: rgba(63,185,80,0.08); }
  .badge-purple{ color: var(--purple); border-color: rgba(188,140,255,0.35);background: rgba(188,140,255,0.08); }
  .badge-orange{ color: var(--orange); border-color: rgba(240,136,62,0.35); background: rgba(240,136,62,0.08); }

  /* ── STATS ROW ── */
  .stats-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .stat-card {
    background: var(--bg2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px 18px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  }

  .stat-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--cyan);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--cyan);
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .stat-label {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--text2);
    margin-top: 6px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  /* ── SECTION ── */
  .section-label {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text3);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .section-label::after {
    content: '';
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
  }

  /* ── TWO COL ── */
  .two-col {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  /* ── CARD ── */
  .card {
    background: var(--bg2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 22px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }

  .card:hover { border-color: rgba(88,166,255,0.4); }

  .card-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text2);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

  /* ── ROLES ── */
  .role-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .role-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .role-icon {
    font-size: 18px;
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    background: rgba(88,166,255,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(88,166,255,0.15);
  }

  .role-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
  .role-org  { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text2); margin-top: 2px; }

  /* ── SKILLS ── */
  .skill-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }

  .skill-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text2);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .skill-bar {
    height: 5px;
    background: var(--bg3);
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .skill-fill {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 3px;
    transition: width 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  }

  /* ── PROJECTS ── */
  .project-card {
    background: var(--bg2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .project-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 3px;
  }

  .project-card:hover { transform: translateX(4px); }

  .proj-title {
    font-size: 14.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .proj-desc {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--text2);
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .proj-tags {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .proj-tag {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10.5px;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text3);
  }

  /* ── TERMINAL ── */
  .terminal {
    background: #010409;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .terminal-bar {
    background: var(--bg3);
    padding: 10px 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .t-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; }

  .terminal-body {
    padding: 20px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .t-prompt { color: var(--green); }
  .t-cmd    { color: var(--text); }
  .t-key    { color: var(--cyan); }
  .t-val    { color: var(--orange); }
  .t-str    { color: var(--purple); }
  .t-comment{ color: var(--text3); }
  .t-cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px; height: 14px;
    background: var(--cyan);
    vertical-align: middle;
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
  }

  @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  .footer {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 24px 0 8px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text3);
  }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; text-align: center; }
    .badge-row { justify-content: center; }
    .stats-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .two-col   { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  /* ── CONTACT ── */
  .contact-section {
    background: var(--bg2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 28px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .contact-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .contact-card {
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 14px;
    text-align: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    display: block;
  }

  .contact-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  .contact-card.github:hover  { border-color: #e6edf3; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(230,237,243,0.1); }
  .contact-card.linkedin:hover{ border-color: #0a66c2; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(10,102,194,0.2); }
  .contact-card.email:hover   { border-color: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(240,136,62,0.2); }
  .contact-card.whatsapp:hover{ border-color: #25d366; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(37,211,102,0.2); }

  .contact-icon {
    font-size: 26px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .contact-platform {
    font-size: 11px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: var(--text3);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  }

  .contact-handle {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .github   .contact-handle { color: #e6edf3; }
  .linkedin .contact-handle { color: #58a6ff; }
  .email    .contact-handle { color: var(--orange); }
  .whatsapp .contact-handle { color: #25d366; }

  /* ── MAIL FORM ── */
  .mail-form-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text2);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .form-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .form-field {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .form-field label {
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text3);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  .form-field input,
  .form-field textarea,
  .form-field select {
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    resize: none;
  }

  .form-field input::placeholder,
  .form-field textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text3); }

  .form-field input:focus,
  .form-field textarea:focus,
  .form-field select:focus {
    border-color: var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(88,166,255,0.1);
  }

  .form-field select option { background: var(--bg2); }

  .form-field.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

  .send-btn {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 4px;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f6feb, #388bfd);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .send-btn:hover {
    opacity: 0.9;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(31,111,235,0.4);
  }

  .send-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

  .toast {
    display: none;
    margin-top: 12px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: rgba(63,185,80,0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(63,185,80,0.35);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--green);
    font-size: 13px;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  }

  @media (max-width: 700px) {
    .contact-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .form-row     { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="container">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <div class="hero">
    <div class="photo-wrap">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Ved Shankar Jha">
      <div class="status-dot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-text">
      <div class="terminal-tag">~/ved-shankar-jha $ whoami</div>
      <h1>Vedant <span>Shankar Jha</span></h1>
      <div class="hero-sub">
        B.Tech ENTC &nbsp;·&nbsp; <span class="accent">GECA '29</span> &nbsp;·&nbsp; Builder · Leader · Thinker
      </div>
      <div class="badge-row">
        <span class="badge badge-blue">⚡ ENTC Engineer</span>
        <span class="badge badge-green">🎙️ CPC Ops Executive</span>
        <span class="badge badge-purple">🏛️ Students Council</span>
        <span class="badge badge-orange">📋 Class Representative</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATS -->
  <div class="stats-row">
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num">3+</div>
      <div class="stat-label">Hackathons</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num">3</div>
      <div class="stat-label">Leadership Roles</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num">MH</div>
      <div class="stat-label">CPC Statewide</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card">
      <div class="stat-num">'29</div>
      <div class="stat-label">Graduating</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TERMINAL -->
  <div class="terminal">
    <div class="terminal-bar">
      <div class="t-dot" style="background:#f85149"></div>
      <div class="t-dot" style="background:#f0883e"></div>
      <div class="t-dot" style="background:#3fb950"></div>
      <span style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;color:#6e7681;margin-left:8px">ved@geca ~ bash</span>
    </div>
    <div class="terminal-body">
      <div><span class="t-prompt">ved@geca</span><span class="t-comment">:</span><span class="t-key">~</span><span class="t-comment">$</span> <span class="t-cmd">cat profile.json</span></div>
      <div>{</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"name"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Vedant Shankar Jha"</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"college"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Government College of Engineering, CSN"</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"branch"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Electronics &amp; Telecommunication Engineering"</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"year"</span>: <span class="t-val">2</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"ambition"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Product Management × AI × Leadership"</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"ride"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Royal Enfield 🏍️"</span>,</div>
      <div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="t-key">"status"</span>: <span class="t-str">"Building, Leading, Shipping"</span></div>
      <div>}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px"><span class="t-prompt">ved@geca</span><span class="t-comment">:</span><span class="t-key">~</span><span class="t-comment">$</span> <span class="t-cursor"></span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ROLES + SKILLS -->
  <div class="two-col" style="margin-bottom:24px">
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--cyan)"></div> Leadership Roles</div>

      <div class="role-item">
        <div class="role-icon">🎙️</div>
        <div>
          <div class="role-name">Operations Executive</div>
          <div class="role-org">College Pe Charcha · Maharashtra-wide</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="role-item">
        <div class="role-icon">🏛️</div>
        <div>
          <div class="role-name">Students Council Coordinator</div>
          <div class="role-org">GECA · Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="role-item">
        <div class="role-icon">📋</div>
        <div>
          <div class="role-name">Class Representative</div>
          <div class="role-org">ENTC Dept · GECA 2027–29 Batch</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-title"><div class="dot" style="background:var(--purple)"></div> Tech Stack</div>

      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-header"><span>Python / AI-ML</span><span style="color:var(--cyan)">85%</span></div>
        <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:85%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#58a6ff,#79c0ff)"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-header"><span>Streamlit / Data Viz</span><span style="color:var(--purple)">78%</span></div>
        <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:78%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#bc8cff,#d2a8ff)"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-header"><span>HTML / CSS / JS</span><span style="color:var(--green)">72%</span></div>
        <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:72%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3fb950,#56d364)"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-header"><span>MATLAB / EDC</span><span style="color:var(--orange)">65%</span></div>
        <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:65%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f0883e,#ffa657)"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="skill-group">
        <div class="skill-header"><span>Leadership / Ops</span><span style="color:var(--cyan)">90%</span></div>
        <div class="skill-bar"><div class="skill-fill" style="width:90%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#58a6ff,#79c0ff)"></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROJECTS -->
  <div class="section-label">Featured Projects</div>

  <div class="project-card" style="border-left-color:var(--cyan)">
    <div class="project-card" style="border:none;padding:0">
      <div class="proj-title">🌍 BharatClimate Twin — ISRO BAH-2026</div>
      <div class="proj-desc">AI-powered Digital Twin of India's Climate System using ConvLSTM, U-Net & FourCastNet (AFNO). Integrates INSAT-3D, MOSDAC, IMD & ERA5 data into the BCIS framework — real-time prediction, visualization & alerts.</div>
      <div class="proj-tags">
        <span class="proj-tag">ConvLSTM</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">U-Net</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">AFNO</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">INSAT-3D</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">ERA5</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">Streamlit</span>
        <span class="proj-tag">ISRO</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="project-card" style="border-left-color:var(--green)">
    <div class="project-card" style="border:none;padding:0">
      <div class="proj-title">🏥 AarogyaX — AI Health Companion</div>

<script>
function sendMail() {
  const name    = document.getElementById('f-name').value.trim();
  const email   = document.getElementById('f-email').value.trim();
  const subject = document.getElementById('f-subject').value || 'Query from Portfolio';
  const contact = document.getElementById('f-contact').value.trim();
  const message = document.getElementById('f-message').value.trim();

  if (!name || !message) {
    alert('Please fill in your name and message at minimum.');
    return;
  }

  const body = [
    `Hi Ved,`,
    ``,
    message,
    ``,
    `---`,
    `From: ${name}`,
    email   ? `Email: ${email}`   : '',
    contact ? `Contact: ${contact}` : '',
    `Topic: ${subject}`,
  ].filter(l => l !== null).join('\n');

  const mailto = `mailto:vjha87739@gmail.com?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject + ' — from ' + name)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
  window.location.href = mailto;

  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  toast.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(() => toast.style.display = 'none', 4000);
}
</script>
